description: Unidad de riego is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Executive Council of the Spanish Geographical Information Infrastructure (CODIIGE). Information on areas with land concentrations broken down into Contour, Agreements, Bases, Projects, Irrigation and Environmental Impact Studies. It is part of the land consolidation projects carried out by the companies Tracasa and Riegos de Navarra with the CP2000 program. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Irrigation unit" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Agricultural and aquaculture facilities, Instalaciones agrícolas y de acuicultura, Parcelas catastrales, Dataset no público. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
